controls.name: Fixed Ordinary Burst Bounded Native Reads
controls.description: Verifies that a fixed burst of 4 concurrent ordinary reconcileGroup triggers on the same group results in <= 2 actual listRooms calls, while all 4 callers resolve successfully.

controls.name: Multi-Group Isolation Without Cross-Coalescing
controls.description: Confirms that concurrent triggers on distinct call groups (group 1 and group 2) execute independent passes without suppressing each other.

controls.name: Trigger During Trailing Pass Leads to Fresh Pass
controls.description: Ensures that a trigger arriving while a trailing pass is already active schedules a subsequent fresh pass, preventing lost wakeups.

controls.name: Distinct Ended Events Processed Individually
controls.description: Guarantees that distinct screen-ended {identity, at} events are each processed under their own canonical reconciliation pass and are never batched or dropped.

controls.name: Native SDK Error Identity and Recovery
controls.description: Verifies that when a native media pass fails, all concurrent callers waiting on that pass reject with the exact same error instance, and that subsequent retries succeed cleanly.

controls.name: Signed Duplicate Webhook Still Reconciles
controls.description: Verifies that duplicate signed webhooks still initiate reconciliation after durable deduplication in webhook_events table.

controls.name: Clean Shutdown Drain and Rejection
controls.description: Validates that onModuleDestroy drains all in-flight passes and queued ended-event jobs before pool.end(), and that requests arriving after shutdown begins are rejected without pool-closed errors.

controls.name: reconcilePass Exact Byte Reversal Proof
controls.description: Proves that the reconcilePass helper body is 100% byte-for-byte identical to the original reconcileGroup body lines 75-104 of apps/api/src/modules/calls/call-lifecycle.service.ts.

controls.name: Deterministic Cleanup Settlement
controls.description: Verifies that the ephemeral test schema is dropped CASCADE, Redis connections closed, app closed, and pg pool ended cleanly.
